stagger.note: a hit staggers the dead one with the weapon's staggerChance (this is the default), stopping its walk for the zombie's stagger seconds (data/tuning.json); after a stagger ends it cannot be staggered again for immunity seconds. Every landed hit shows a flinch whether or not it staggers, and any landed hit during a bite's wind-up cancels the bite (docs/41, step 1; the old `interrupts` field is retired). The cancel is a lever (Michael, 2026-10-23): what a cancelled bite costs the dead one (the bite's whole cooldown, zombie.cooldown in data/tuning.json; half of it the softer setting) and whether every hit cancels or only a staggering one are revisited after real combat testing, read by check("melee")'s lone-zombie row

bleed.note: a landed bite opens a wound with this chance, one more stack each (to max); the wound drains dpsByStacks[stacks - 1] a second, the timer is refreshed by each new bite and runs out by itself after duration seconds; a bandage stops it. Michael's bounds: five fresh stacks kill from full health in 10 s (not under 8 to 10 s), and one stack is a nuisance (under 5 health in all)

burn.note: burning (#14, Michael 2026-10-15): like bleeding but capped at one; a body burning loses dps a second for duration seconds, a new source refreshing the timer and never stacking, and never more than cap over one burn however often refreshed (Michael: never more than 10 against 100, the dead's health then; the cap is kept at 10 against 150 since docs/41 step 6, a number not a ratio, until Michael says otherwise). Only the dead burn, never a player. Sources: a weapon's `ignite` chance (the torch's 0.25 in data/items.json), the fireball and a fire arrow always (their `ignite`)

infection.note: a landed bite infects with this chance; the moodle goes green, yellow, orange, red over this many in-game days; it does nothing else yet (docs/02 question 29b)

combo.note: the third hit on one dead one within `window` seconds always floors it; switched off for testing (Michael, 2026-10-12), the code kept

finisher.note: what a blow on a downed dead one is multiplied by (was 2)

dual.note: an off-hand swing leaves you exposed for `window` seconds: a blow takes `front` times its damage from the front arc, `side` times from the sides, `behind` times (fatal) from behind; `lockout` is the share of a swing before the other hand may swing; `offDamage` multiplies the off hand's blows (1 = full; World of Warcraft's flat penalty would be 0.5) (docs/21)

blow.note: pointBlank: tiles this close are always hit; knockdownChance: the share of hits that floor the dead for a weapon with no knockdown of its own: 0 since docs/41 step 3 (was 0.3, 'high; for the combat pass'), so only a weapon with its own knockdown floors (the mace, the halberd's thrust, the shove); tiredDamage: a swing the bar cannot pay for (stamina below its cost; docs/41 step 4) lands at this share; hitStop, hitStopKill: seconds the world freezes on a hit and on a kill (0.07 and 0.12 since docs/41 step 1); swingMove: the walk's share while the swing's animation plays, the commitment to a swing (docs/41 step 1)

bow.note: the fireball as a flare (#156, Michael 2026-10-17): fireballGlow its light in flight, flareRadius and flareSeconds the light where it lands (light only), kindleRadius how near it lights a campfire or mounted torch; the bow's draw and every arrow's and thrown thing's flight (archery.js tunables; a bow's own drawTime, braceDrawTime, damage, and a thrown block override them): range and speed in tiles, heights in px; drawSpeed and braceMove the walk while drawing and braced; recoverTime the pause after a shot

shove.note: Space (docs/41 step 2): no damage, a push of knockback tiles, a stagger of stagger seconds, a knockdown by chance, on up to targets of the dead in the wedge whatever the Multi-hit setting; cooldown is also the recovery in which no swing starts
